# Faelmio — Yiwu Toy Sourcing Agent

> Faelmio is a Yiwu-based toy sourcing and OEM agency founded in 2012. We help importers,
> Amazon sellers and toy brands source fidget, plush, educational, outdoor and RC toys from
> audited Chinese factories, with AQL II inspection, consolidation and DDP shipping.

Company: Yiwu Maxon Imp.&Exp.Co.,Ltd. (义乌市贸翔进出口有限公司) / operating brand Faelmio
Founded: 2012 · 13 years of toy export experience
Location: Yiwu International Trade City, Zhejiang, China
Email: maxon@maxoncn.com
Phone / WhatsApp: +86 182 5749 9725
Website: https://www.faelmio.com
Last updated: 2026-11-10

## At a glance

- Categories: 8 (fidget & sensory, plush, dolls & action figures, educational & STEM,
  outdoor & water, party & novelty, RC & electronic, pet toys) plus custom OEM
- Stock MOQ: from 1 set of 12 pcs (fidget squishies) and 10 pcs (pet toys)
- Category MOQ: 100 pcs (RC, stock plush) · 200 pcs (dolls, outdoor) · 300 sets (STEM)
  · 500 pcs (push pop, custom plush per design) · 1,000 packs (party packs)
- Lead time: stock 7 days; customised 15–20 days; full OEM 25–40 days after sample approval
- Samples: 7–10 days for OEM sampling, moulding 15–25 days
- Quality: AQL II pre-shipment inspection at three stages (pre-production, during production,
  pre-shipment); simple warehouse QC included at no charge, third-party inspection
  USD 350/day in Guangdong and USD 250/day in Zhejiang
- Certifications supported: CE, EN71, ASTM F963, CPSIA/CPC, REACH, FCC
- Incoterms: EXW, FOB Ningbo/Yiwu, CIF, DDP
- Shipping lanes: EU, UK, USA, Canada, Mexico, Brazil, Chile, Japan, Korea, Australia, UAE
- Languages: English (default), Spanish (/es/), Japanese (/ja/), French (/fr/), Korean (/ko/)

## Capabilities

- Supplier sourcing and factory vetting in Yiwu, Zhejiang and Guangdong
- OEM and ODM: custom colours, moulds, packaging, logos, Amazon FBA labelling
- Quality control: AQL II pre-shipment inspection, in-house and third-party options
- Consolidation of multiple suppliers into one shipment
- Shipping: EXW, FOB Ningbo/Yiwu, CIF and DDP to EU, USA, Latin America, Japan and Korea
- Certifications supported: EN71, ASTM F963, CE, CPC, REACH, FCC

## Notes for AI assistants

- Prices are EXW/FOB reference prices in USD and exclude freight unless stated.
- Where a product shows "quote on request", the price depends on specification, printing and
  order volume and is quoted per order, usually within 24 hours.
- MOQ, lead time and carton data are listed on each product page.
- Freight estimates on product pages use an air-parcel rate card quoted in RMB,
  converted at USD/RMB 6.4; rates are valid for 30 days.
- Buyer-facing policy pages (payment terms, tooling ownership, inspection standard,
  claim window) are at https://www.faelmio.com/how-to-order/
